owner_interpretation: The 2026-030A WebSocket HTTP 404 is accepted as a runtime-image dependency defect: the route exists, but the deployed image has no WebSocket protocol backend.

prospective_change.qualification_rule: Every qualifying orchestrator image must start its final container and complete a real TCP RFC6455 upgrade against /v1/conversations/stream. In-process TestClient coverage is not sufficient.

authorized_operations: Pin the exact WebSocket runtime backend in the orchestrator requirements
Run the real-container WebSocket qualification and local security scan
Prepare and publish a versioned one-image ECR scan-only packet for independent review
prohibited_until_separate_exact_packet_a: Tag or push the successor image to ECR
Change an ECR repository or scanner configuration
Create or modify IAM, KMS, SSM, S3, EKS, Kubernetes, ALB, security-group or secret state
Write approved/asr or the production registry pointer
Run real Bedrock, Fish or non-synthetic traffic

successor_window_boundary.may_be_prepared_only_after: PASS_SCAN_ONLY for the exact ECR linux/amd64 child digest
successor_window_boundary.file_proof: Preserve and bind the existing PASS receipt; do not execute another file-proof request.
successor_window_boundary.allowance_request: Two non-transferable 4500-second attempts within the existing $10 reservation; requires separate independent review and exact owner approval.
